title: Sum-of-squares and Sherali-Adams need size 2^Theta(tw) for Tseitin on graphs built from short cycles
subject: Semialgebraic proof complexity of Tseitin formulas beyond expanders
conclusion: A tangle of order k gives Tseitin formulas a pseudo-expectation up to degree k-1 that defeats Sherali-Adams and sum-of-squares, so SoS degree is the carving width up to 4 and Sherali-Adams degree lies between cvw and 3cvw/2. With cell restrictions, SoS and Sherali-Adams size is 2^Theta(tw) on grids, d-dimensional grids, plane graphs with short faces and walls, the first such bounds beyond expanders that we found.
